description: PASS2-15: private_ipv6? uses /^fc00|^fd00/ regex which requires 4 hex chars. ULA fc00::/7 covers ALL addresses starting with fc or fd (e.g., fc80::1, fd12::1). These are NOT caught, allowing SSRF to unique-local addresses. Fix: use starts_with?("fc") || starts_with?("fd"). File: src/vug/url_validator.cr:74-85

comments.text: Landed in 3f0ba46 — IPv6 ULA detection uses starts_with?("fc") || starts_with?("fd") covering full /7 range.

title: SECURITY: IPv6 ULA detection regex misses valid ULA addresses
